rules.statement: In a mortgage bond case, any adjustment of the decree must be certified under section 349 of the Ceylon Civil Procedure Code for it to be recognized by any Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, according to the Ceylon Code any adjustment of the decree has to be certified, and the certification is made the only proof of payment or adjustment that any Court may recognize."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 349 of the Ceylon Civil Procedure Code
